Order the sides of the triangle $△RST$ above from the shortest to the longest.
question.worked_solution:
First, let's find the missing angle $T.$ Since the interior angles of a triangle sum to ${180}^{∘},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠R+m∠S+m∠T & ={180}^{∘} \\ {40}^{∘}+{103}^{∘}+m∠T & ={180}^{∘} \\ m∠T & ={180}^{∘}-{143}^{∘} \\ m∠T & ={37}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since $∠T$ is the smallest angle, its opposite side $\overset{―}{RS}$ is the shortest side of the triangle.

Since $∠S$ is the largest angle, its opposite side $\overset{―}{RT}$ must be the longest side of the triangle. 

So, we have

$$
RS<ST<RT
$$

and therefore, the required order is

$$
\overset{―}{RS},\overset{―}{ST},\overset{―}{RT}.
$$
